name: pmp-regression
description: PMP regression tests (Cucumber + Playwright + Allure) against staging. Run with npm run bdd

scripts.bdd: npm run bdd:auth && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js
scripts.bdd:sign-in: npm run bdd:auth && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --profile signin
scripts.bdd:lockout: npm run bdd:auth && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --profile lockout
scripts.bdd:admin-portal: npm run bdd:auth && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --profile adminPortal
scripts.bdd:vendor-portal: npm run bdd:auth && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --profile vendorPortal
scripts.bdd:member-portal: npm run bdd:auth && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --profile memberPortal
scripts.bdd:check: npm run typecheck && npm run bdd:dry
scripts.bdd:report: allure generate reports/allure-results --output reports/allure-report --clean --open --host 127.0.0.1 --name 'PMP - Regression Test Report'
